Preserve mint/sage bob hair, a small pink flower at viewer-right temple, compact white angel wings, short ivory petal dress with dark green underskirt, gold clasp, two short dusty pink ribbons, small boots. Match image 1's fairy scale and silhouette: around three heads tall, small face with restrained 1-2 pixel eye marks at final game scale, fine broken dark-green pixel contours, soft grouped highlights, no heavy cartoon outline. Intended visible size 39x36 game pixels inside a 48x48 frame, so wings are spread horizontally, arms low, legs compact. All extremities visible and separated; no long ornaments, no VFX or ground shadow. Render as a deliberately low-resolution sprite enlarged with crisp square pixel clusters to fill the middle of a square transparent image, leaving ample alpha margin. Keep the character's high detail reduced to the same visual density as image 1; this is not a painted or vector chibi illustration. No text, no labels, no atlas, no multiple copies, no checkerboard or background.
